title: 第013章 苏府震怒布天罗第014章 长街独行万众瞩
lines: 清晨的第一缕天光照亮的，是城主府西北角那一片被大火肆虐后的断壁残垣，焦黑的木料还在冒着缕缕青烟，空气中弥漫着刺鼻的焦糊味和水汽。仆役们疲惫不堪地清理着现场，脸上都带着劫后余生的惶然。更刺眼的，是马厩侧墙上那行焦黑狰狞、却依旧清晰无比的大字：
“明日午时，登门拜访。——秦夜”
每一个笔画，都像是一记响亮的耳光，狠狠抽在苏远山的脸上，也抽在所有城主府护卫的心上。昨夜的混乱、惊恐、屈辱，伴随着这行字，在晨光中无所遁形。
议事厅内，气氛比昨夜更加死寂。苏远山没有发怒，他只是坐在主位上，脸色是一种近乎铁青的平静，但那双眼睛里燃烧的火焰，几乎要将眼前的一切都焚毁。他的手紧紧抓着紫檀木的扶手，手背上青筋虬结，指节因为用力而发白。
“说说吧。”苏远山的声音嘶哑，像是砂纸摩擦，“火是怎么起来的？人，又是怎么没抓到的？”
负责昨夜西北角区域防卫的小队长“噗通”一声跪倒在地，浑身颤抖如筛糠：“城……城主恕罪！是……是杂物库房内部突然起火，火势蔓延极快，加之有灯油助燃……属下等全力扑救，但……但火起时，周围并未发现任何可疑人影，只在救火时，才看到墙上那行字……”
“没有任何可疑人影？”苏远山的声音陡然拔高，带着一种令人心寒的尖锐，“你的意思是，那火是自己烧起来的？那行字，是自己飞到墙上去的？！”
“卑职……卑职无能！卑职该死！”小队长磕头如捣蒜，额头很快见了血。
“你是该死。”苏远山冷漠地吐出四个字，然后看向一旁的赵刚，“赵统领，昨夜全府戒严，三步一岗，五步一哨，连只耗子都该被揪出来。结果呢？让人在库房放了火，在墙上留了字，然后大摇大摆地走了！你手下的人，眼睛都长在屁股上了吗？！”
赵刚脸色惨白，额头上冷汗涔涔，单膝跪地：“卑职失职！甘受任何责罚！但……但那贼子实在太过狡猾，他似乎……似乎对府内布局、护卫换班甚至仆役作息都了如指掌！起火点选在防卫相对松懈的西北角，趁换岗和夜间查哨的短暂混乱潜入，得手后混入救火惊慌的仆役人群中脱身……这绝非临时起意，定是经过周密探查和计划！”
“周密计划？他一个被关在秦家后院长大、连城门都没出过几次的废物，哪来的本事对城主府‘了如指掌’？！”苏远山猛地一拍桌子，站起身来，厉声道，“只有一个可能！内鬼！我们中间，一定有内鬼在给他传递消息！绘制地图！甚至……帮他混入府中！”
此言一出，厅内众人神色各异，彼此交换着惊疑不定的眼神，气氛瞬间变得更加微妙和紧张。内鬼？会是谁？是护卫中有人被收买？还是仆役里有眼线？或者是……地位更高的人？
苏清雪一直沉默地坐在下首，此刻缓缓起身，开口道：“父亲息怒。内鬼之事，不可不查，但亦不可操之过急，以免中了贼人离间之计。当务之急，是应对他今日午时的‘登门拜访’。”
她转向众人，声音清冷而清晰：“贼子昨夜所为，看似嚣张，实则暴露了他的意图。他选在西北角放火留字，而非府库、书房等真正要害，说明他目前尚无能力或不敢正面冲击我城主府核心。所谓‘登门拜访’，更像是一种示威，一种心理战，意图搅乱我方阵脚，让我们自乱阵脚，他好从中渔利。”
苏远山深吸几口气，强迫自己冷静下来。女儿的分析不无道理。“那依你之见，该当如何？”
“他将时间、地点说得如此明确，不外乎两种可能。”苏清雪冷静分析，“其一，虚张声势，根本不会来，只为继续制造恐慌，打击我城主府威信。其二，他真有依仗，打算在众目睽睽之下，做出一些更惊人的举动，以达成其某种目的——比如，彻底践踏我城主府尊严，或者，在紫阳宗使者面前，演一出好戏。”
提到紫阳宗使者，苏远山眼神一凝。使者午后便到，若届时城中依然如此混乱，甚至让那秦夜在使者面前闹出什么事端，那他苏远山在紫阳宗眼中的分量，将一落千丈，甚至可能影响到苏清雪与少宗主的婚事！
“所以，我们必须做好万全准备，应对任何一种可能。”苏清雪继续道，“首先，全城戒严令不变，但午时前后，将主要力量收缩回城主府周边，尤其是正门、侧门、围墙各处，布下天罗地网。他不是要‘登门’吗？我们就敞开大门，‘请君入瓮’！”
“其次，府内重要人物、尤其是父亲和女儿，身边必须加派最强护卫。府库、书房等地，陷阱机关全部开启，弓弩手就位。狼卫分成明暗两组，明组护卫要人，暗组埋伏于各处要道、屋顶、阴影，一旦贼子现身，务必一击必杀，绝不容他再逃脱！”
“第三，对紫阳宗使者，需提前沟通。可坦言城中有宵小作乱，正在全力清剿，为保使者安全，请其暂缓入城，或在城外别院稍歇，待午时过后，局势明朗，再隆重迎入府中。如此，既可避免使者涉险，也可避免其看到不该看的场面。”
“最后，”苏清雪美眸中寒光一闪，“秦家那边，也不能放过。秦夜毕竟是秦家出来的人，此事他们脱不了干系。可责令秦烈，午时之前，必须将他所知的关于秦夜的一切，尤其是其可能藏身之处、同党信息，悉数报来，并派出秦家高手，协助我们在城中搜捕。若秦夜今日真敢出现，也要让秦家派人，参与围剿！”
一番安排，条理清晰，考虑周全，既针对外敌，也敲打内患，更顾及了紫阳宗的面子。厅内众人听了，心中稍定，看向苏清雪的目光也多了一丝敬佩。这位大小姐，不仅天赋出众，心机手腕也非同一般。
苏远山脸色稍霁，点了点头：“就按清雪说的办。赵刚！”
“卑职在！”
“立刻去安排！将所有人手分成三班，轮流警戒休息，务必保持最佳状态迎接午时！狼卫调动，由你亲自负责，若有差池，提头来见！”
“是！卑职领命！”
“还有，派人去秦家，把秦烈给本城主‘请’来！告诉他，午时之前，若拿不出有用的东西，他这个秦家大长老，也就当到头了！”
content_en:
The first ray of skylight in the morning illuminated the ruins of the fire-ravaged northwest corner of the city lord's palace. The charred wood was still emitting wisps of smoke, and the air was filled with the pungent smell of burnt wood and water vapor. The servants were exhaustingly cleaning up the scene, with a look of panic on their faces. What's even more dazzling is the charred and hideous, but still clear, large characters on the side wall of the stable:
"I'll come to visit you at noon tomorrow. - Qin Ye"
Every stroke was like a loud slap in the face, hard on Su Yuanshan's face, and also on the hearts of all the guards of the City Lord's Mansion. The chaos, panic, and humiliation of last night, accompanied by these lines, were invisible in the morning light.
In the conference hall, the atmosphere was even deadlier than last night. Su Yuanshan was not angry, he just sat in the main seat, his face was almost livid and calm, but the fire burning in his eyes almost burned everything in front of him. His hands tightly grasped the rosewood armrests, the backs of his hands were knotted with veins, and his knuckles were white from exertion.
"Tell me about it." Su Yuanshan's voice was hoarse, like sandpaper rubbing, "How did the fire start? How did the person not be caught?"
The team leader in charge of the defense of the northwest corner last night fell to his knees with a bang, and his whole body was shaking like chaff: "City... City Lord, forgive me! It was... a fire suddenly broke out inside the sundries warehouse. The fire spread very quickly, and there was lamp oil to help the combustion... The subordinates tried their best to put out the fire, but... when the fire broke out, no suspicious figures were found around. It was only when we were putting out the fire that we saw the words on the wall..."
"There aren't any suspicious figures?" Su Yuanshan's voice suddenly rose, with a chilling sharpness, "You mean, the fire started on its own? Those lines of words flew onto the wall on their own?!"
"Disgraceful position... Disgraceful position and incompetence! Disgraceful position deserves death!" The team leader kowtowed as if he was pounding garlic, and blood soon appeared on his forehead.
"You deserve to die." Su Yuanshan spat out four words indifferently, and then looked at Zhao Gang aside, "Commander Zhao, the whole government was under martial law last night. There was a post every three steps and a sentry every five steps. Even a mouse should be caught. The result? Someone set a fire in the warehouse, left a message on the wall, and then walked away in a big way! Do all the people under your command have eyes on their butts?!"
Zhao Gang's face was pale, with cold sweat on his forehead, and he knelt down on one knee: "Horrible dereliction of duty! I am willing to accept any punishment! But...but that thief is too cunning. He seems...as if he knows the layout of the house, the guard shifts, and even the servants' schedules." Palm! The fire started in the relatively lax northwest corner, and he took advantage of the brief chaos of guard changing and night patrol to sneak in, and then escaped among the panicked servants fighting the fire... This was definitely not a temporary move, it must have been a thorough investigation and plan!"
"A thorough plan? How could he, a loser who grew up in the Qin family's backyard and never even left the city gates, have the ability to know the city lord's mansion so well?!" Su Yuanshan slammed the table, stood up, and said sternly, "There is only one possibility! The mole! There must be an mole among us who is passing news to him! Drawing a map! Even... helping him sneak into the mansion!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone in the hall had different expressions and exchanged doubtful glances with each other. The atmosphere instantly became more subtle and tense. Insider? Who could it be? Was someone among the guards bribed? Or is there an informant among the servants? Or... someone with a higher status?
Su Qingxue had been sitting silently at the bottom. Now she stood up slowly and said, "Father, please calm down. You must investigate the matter of the inner ghost, but you must not do it too hastily, lest you fall into the thieves' plan to alienate you. The top priority is to deal with his 'visit' at noon today."
She turned to everyone and spoke in a cold and clear voice: "What the thief did last night seemed arrogant, but in fact it revealed his intentions. He chose to set fire to leave a message in the northwest corner instead of the real key points such as the treasury and study room, which shows that he is currently unable or does not dare to attack the core of our city lord's palace head-on. The so-called 'visit' is more like a demonstration, a kind of psychological warfare, with the intention of disrupting our position and making us chaotic, so that he can profit from it."
Su Yuanshan took a few deep breaths and forced himself to calm down. My daughter's analysis makes sense. "Then what do you think should be done?"
"He made the time and place so clear, and there are only two possibilities." Su Qingxue analyzed calmly. "The first is a bluff, and he will not come at all, just to continue to create panic and undermine the prestige of our City Lord's Mansion. The second is that he really has support and plans to make some more shocking moves in full view of the public to achieve some of his goals - such as completely trampling on the dignity of our City Lord's Mansion, or putting on a good show in front of the Purple Sun Sect's envoys."
When Su Yuanshan mentioned the envoy of Ziyang Sect, his eyes narrowed. The envoy will arrive in the afternoon. If the city is still in such chaos and Qin Ye causes trouble in front of the envoy, then Su Yuanshan's weight in the eyes of the Ziyang Sect will plummet, and it may even affect Su Qingxue's marriage to the young sect leader!
"So, we must be fully prepared to deal with any possibility." Su Qingxue continued, "First of all, the city's martial law will remain unchanged, but around noon, the main force will be withdrawn back to the surroundings of the city lord's palace, especially the main entrance, side entrances, and walls, and a dragnet will be laid. Isn't he going to 'come to the door'? We will open the door and 'invite you into the urn'!"
"Secondly, important people in the house, especially fathers and daughters, must be surrounded by the strongest guards. In the treasury, study and other places, all traps are activated, and crossbowmen are in place. The wolf guards are divided into two groups, the light group and the dark group. The bright group guards the important people, and the dark group ambush in various thoroughfares, rooftops, and shadows. Once the thief appears, he must be killed with one strike and he will never be allowed to escape again!"
"Third, we need to communicate with the envoys of the Ziyang Sect in advance. We can frankly admit that there is a small disturbance in the city, and we are trying our best to clean it up. To ensure the safety of the envoys, ask them to postpone entering the city, or take a rest in a courtyard outside the city. After noon, when the situation becomes clear, we can then grandly welcome the envoys into the mansion. In this way, we can not only avoid the envoys from being in danger, but also avoid seeing scenes that they should not see."
"Finally," a cold light flashed in Su Qingxue's beautiful eyes, "the Qin family can't let it go either. Qin Ye is a member of the Qin family after all, and they have nothing to do with this matter. But Qin Lie must be ordered to report everything he knows before noon. Everything about Qin Ye, especially his possible hiding place and information about his accomplices, has been reported, and Qin family experts have been dispatched to help us search for him in the city. If Qin Ye really dares to show up today, we must send people from the Qin family to participate in the encirclement and suppression!"
The arrangement was clear and well-considered. It not only targeted foreign enemies, but also dealt with internal troubles, and also took into account the Ziyang Sect's face. After hearing this, everyone in the hall calmed down and looked at Su Qingxue with a hint of admiration. This eldest lady not only has outstanding talent, but also extraordinary scheming skills.
Su Yuanshan's face softened slightly and he nodded: "Just do as Qingxue said. Zhao Gang!"
"The humble position is here!"
"Go and make arrangements immediately! Divide all personnel into three shifts and take turns to guard and rest. Be sure to be in the best condition to welcome the noon hour! You are personally responsible for the mobilization of the wolf guards. If there is any discrepancy, please report it to us!"
"Yes! I humbly accept my order!"
"Also, send someone to the Qin family and 'invite' Qin Lie to the city lord! Tell him that if he can't come up with anything useful before noon, he, the great elder of the Qin family, will be done for!"
"Yes!"
title_en: Chapter 013 The Su Mansion is furious with Bu Tianluo Chapter 014 Walking alone on the long street attracts the attention of everyone
